events.comment: Following instructions and giving instructions are two different skills. I would have preferred to split this LO into two sub-objectives. The dialogue drills (Ex B and F) provide some practice in giving instructions, but students only repeat the given lines rather than giving instructions independently. I have kept the LO combined for now because the textbook does not provide a separate exercise to assess this skill independently.
